driver-web.body: To start and record trips, install Namma Lorry on your Android or iPhone. This web page is for the operations team.

permissions.title: Allow location for your trips

disclosure.title: Only during trips
disclosure.body: Tracking starts when you tap Start trip and stops when you tap End trip. While a trip is running, Namma Lorry records your location in the background, even when the app is closed or the phone is locked, and shows a notification.

disclosure.title: Builds your verified experience
disclosure.body: Kilometres and trips count only from real GPS. Namma Lorry operations also see where the load is during the trip.

disclosure.title: Shared with Namma Lorry operations for this load
disclosure.body: Later, the owner and shipper of that load may see it too. It is kept as your trip record; how long is set out in the privacy policy. No contacts, photos or calls are collected.

battery.title: Keep tracking running
battery.body: Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. This can break your trip record.
battery.openFailed: Couldn't open settings. Open Settings → Apps → Namma Lorry → Battery yourself.

guide.open: Tap Open settings (it opens Namma Lorry’s App info).
xiaomi: Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
Go back and turn on Autostart for Namma Lorry.
vivo: Tap Battery, then Background power consumption, and choose Allow (or turn on Allow high background power consumption).
Turn on Autostart (in i Manager → App manager → Autostart manager on older phones).
oppo: Tap Battery usage and turn on Allow background activity.
Turn on Allow auto launch (Auto launch on some models).
samsung: In Settings → Battery → Background usage limits, make sure Namma Lorry is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
generic: Tap Battery and choose Unrestricted (or Don’t optimise).
If you see Autostart or Auto launch, turn it on.
